 - Adds an additional property to `TsImportType`

**Related issue:**

 - Closes https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/9377

issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

[Oxc had the same bug](https://github.com/oxc-project/oxc/issues/4601)


### Input code

```typescript
type Vite =  typeof import("vite", { assert: { "resolution-mode": "import" } });
```


### Config

```json
{
  "jsc": {
    "transform": {
        "legacyDecorator": true,
        "decoratorMetadata": true,
        "react": {
          // runtime: "automatic", // or classic
          "runtime": "automatic", //

          "useBuiltins": true,
          "development": false,
        },
      },
      "loose": false,
      "parser": {
        "syntax": "typescript",
        "tsx": true
      },
      "target": "es2020",
  },
  "module": {
    "type": "commonjs"
  },

}
```
